# Idempotent Compile Runs

A compile run for a repository and a pull request must be succeeded only once, enforcing no re-triggering of runs.

To prevent unnecessary recompilations and ensure efficient processing.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/storage/schema.py` — `knowledge_compiler.storage.schema.CompileRun`
